eventName: 5th Phase of the Tree Plantation Drive
eventDescription:
With the dedicated participation of Adhi College NSS students, 300 saplings including Vengai, Mahogany, Teak, and Kadamba were planted.
Environmental destruction is one of the major reasons behind many of the challenges we face in our lives. Let us plant more trees, expand our green cover, and leave behind a healthy and prosperous planet for future generations.
